description_en: Queries a paged query list of personal development environment instances with paging support
description_zh: 分页查询个人开发环境实例列表
name: ListServerIdeInstances

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks resource group identifier. You can specify a numeric resource group ID or a full identifier in the format of Serverless_res_group_{tenantId}_{resgId}
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks 资源组标识。支持资源组数字 ID，或 Serverless_res_group_{tenantId}_{resgId} 格式的完整标识
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy match by instance ID or instance name
parameters.help_zh: 按实例 ID 或实例名称进行关键字匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the user who owns the instance. Used to filter instances by owner
parameters.help_zh: 按实例所属用户的账号 ID 过滤
parameters.name: related_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance subtype. Valid values:
PERSONAL_DEV: personal development environment.
DATA_AGENT: Data Agent
parameters.help_zh: 实例子类型。取值 PERSONAL_DEV 表示个人开发环境，DATA_AGENT 表示 Data Agent
parameters.name: sub_type

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 用于继续查询的分页令牌，首次调用无需传入
parameters.name: next_token
